comment: Audio policy for the Samsung Galaxy S10+ (beyond2lte). Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-audio-diag.sh and tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-headphone-diag.sh, installed to /etc/nuxel/audio/audio.json. Nothing here asserts that sound is audible; it constrains HOW the first bring-up may happen so that an unknown amplifier path can never be driven at full scale.

device.card_name_note: beyond-madera is the ALSA card name (what /proc/asound/cards reports) and therefore also the UCM2 directory name. It is the anchor: a config that names any other card is wrong for this device.

safety.comment: LOW-VOLUME-ONLY default. The cap is enforced at the ALSA layer (configs/pipewire/asound-nuxel-safe.conf, softvol max_dB=-6.0) AND clamped again in every generated UCM cset, so a session-manager restore or a direct mixer write cannot defeat it.
banned_by_default: alsactl restore of a stored full-scale profile
any aplay invocation without a bounded -d duration
safety.why_not_a_session_manager_property: A session manager restores a stored volume; that is a convenience, not a safety guarantee. The hard ceiling lives at the ALSA layer and in the generated csets.

card_selection.comment: The card is located by NAME first and by index only as a fallback; a hard-coded card index is never assumed.
card_selection.measured_working_route: hw:0,1 (RDMA1) at 48000 Hz, verified with a bounded low-level aplay (hw_ptr advances, rc=0); 44100 Hz leaves hw_ptr at 0 and returns EIO. RDMA0 does not advance at any tested rate. The static sink is configs/s10plus/pipewire/50-nuxel-s10-alsa.conf.
must_not_assume: a PCM named 'pcmC0D0p' as the only playback PCM

pipeline_walk.comment: nuxelctl audio pipeline walks these stages in order and reports the FIRST stage that is missing, silent or broken. It never reports 'OK' for a stage it could not observe.

evidence: the UCM EnableSequence that was actually applied

never_a_criterion: a writable mixer control (writability is not audibility)
a DAPM widget reporting 'On' without a running PCM

capture.comment: The concrete UCM EnableSequence is GENERATED from a real capture, never invented: the MADERA/CS47L93 control namespace is large and device-specific.

test_tone.comment: A bounded, low-volume tone whose purpose is to make the DAC/DAPM decision observable: the tool asserts PCM state=RUNNING while the tone plays and reports SILENT if the DAC never leaves SETUP. It does not, and cannot, assert that the owner heard anything.

jack.comment: See configs/nuxel/audio/jack-routes.json for the route-switching policy. Jack state is read from ALSA jack kcontrols and codec pin registers; the kcontrol names are discovered, not invented.
